concerns.location: plan.md: Section 3 – Energy‑aware Inference Runs (5 repetitions per configuration)
concerns.text: Only five repetitions per configuration are planned. Power analysis notes a ~70 % chance to detect a medium effect, which may be insufficient for smaller but practically relevant effects. Increase the number of repetitions (e.g., 10–15) or perform a formal power calculation to ensure adequate sensitivity.

concerns.location: plan.md: Section 6 – Statistical Analysis (CPU frequency control)
concerns.text: The plan sets the CPU governor to `performance` and records frequencies, but does not enforce a stable frequency nor adjust for residual scaling/throttling. Variable CPU frequency can confound energy‑per‑token measurements. Add explicit checks (e.g., wait for frequency stabilization) or include frequency as a covariate in the regression.

concerns.location: plan.md: Section 2 – Baseline idle power & Section 3 – Energy‑aware Inference Runs
concerns.text: Energy measurement relies on `pyRAPL` (or fallback `powerstat`) with a simple idle‑baseline subtraction. The construct validity of this approach on the GitHub Actions runner is uncertain, as `pyRAPL` may not capture all power draw (e.g., DRAM, system services). Include a validation step comparing `pyRAPL` readings against an external calibrated wattmeter on a known workload, or at least report measurement uncertainty.
